finding: The exact PrefixGraph tournament contains one complete all-direct candidate before nominated anchor candidates. Any completed-G0-G4 incumbent proof must preserve that candidate explicitly; anchor lower-bound terminals cannot stand in for pricing the all-direct candidate.
exact_current_behavior: direct_payloads are computed exactly once with Zstd-19
_serialize_candidate(..., anchor=None) constructs the complete all-direct artifact
all-direct initializes the PrefixGraph incumbent under exact key (archive_bytes, -1)
each nominated anchor candidate is then compared under exact key (archive_bytes, anchor)
staged_r1_rule: Build or reconstruct the exact all-direct PrefixGraph candidate from the same staged rels/raws/direct_payloads.
If all_direct_bytes < complete_g04_bytes, keep it live as a publishable PrefixGraph candidate.
Apply the cross-representation lower_bound >= complete_g04_bytes terminal only to an anchor continuation whose bound is sound.
On PrefixGraph-winner controls, the proof arm must reproduce the exact process-built PrefixGraph winner across the live all-direct candidate and all surviving anchors.
On G0-G4-winner controls, conclude G0-G4 only after all-direct is priced and every nominated anchor is either fully priced or safely proven non-publishable.
claim_boundary: Evidence-specification/custody correction only. It does not establish proof-firing, runtime, RSS, product selection or release credit.
